morning.caption:
COP31's second draft deal, released Nov 19, removes every direct reference to fossil fuels but keeps a goal of at least 500 million tonnes of carbon capture a year by 2035, still in brackets, and a 35% electrification target.

What it means for investors, regulators and industry at carbonenergynexus.com

midday.caption:
Canada launched a standing federal offer to buy durable carbon removal credits: 19 offers across five pathways, open to departments until 2029. Remova's Alberta BECCS plant, about 20,000 tonnes a year from 2028, is one winner.

More at carbonenergynexus.com

#CarbonRemoval #CDR #Canada #CarbonMarkets

evening.caption:
Jordan launched its National Water Carrier on Nov 18: about $6.6 billion to desalinate 300 million cubic meters a year from the Gulf of Aqaba and pump it 417 km to Amman, with water due by end 2030.

More at carbonenergynexus.com
